description: This file defines an Android ListActivity class, DataList, which displays data retrieved from a content provider, manages cursor lifecycle, and handles user interactions such as item clicks and menu actions.

classes.name: DataList
classes.description: An activity displaying a list of data retrieved via a content URI, allowing user interaction with data items, and providing options menu for requery refresh.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves data cursor from content provider, and sets up the list adapter.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Deactivates the cursor when the activity stops.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Requeries the cursor to refresh data and updates the activity title.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates options menu with a requery item.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item click by constructing an intent with data and starting a Details activity.
